Definition: from a derivative of G534; completion:--finishing.
BiblicalUsage: The finishing of a tower — Jesus' picture of the man who sits down first and counts the cost, so he does not lay the foundation and then run out of money before the tower is done. The word is about completing what was begun.
TheologicalSignificance: I take this as Jesus' plain demand: following him is a whole-life decision, and it should be counted before it is started.
